result_summary.title: Retention policies not applying to sandbox records
result_summary.description: We are seeing a critical issue in the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox environment. Data retention policies seem to be completely ignored, and records are not being cleaned up as expected. This is affecting almost 9,300 users' worth of test data, which is clogging our systems. I suspect this might be tied to the SSO broker configuration used for these accounts, but it could also be a direct retention engine bug. We need to know if the policy engine is failing or if the identity layer is preventing the cleanup from running.

final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case is likely related to a retention policy engine failure, with some evidence suggesting a potential issue with the identity layer preventing cleanup. The affected component is the Data Retention Manager, and the owning team is the Integration team.
